legal_ref: PVM įstatymas Nr. IX-751, 2 str. 32 d. and 19 str. 1-2 d.; 21% set by įstatymas Nr. XI-386 (2009-07-22), 1 str., in force 2009-09-01 (4 str.)
quote: 32. Standartinis PVM tarifas – 21 procento PVM tarifas. — The standard VAT rate is 21%. [XI-386, 4 str.: 'Šis įstatymas įsigalioja 2009 m. rugsėjo 1 d.' — in force 1 September 2009]
source_title: Seimas legal acts register (e-seimas.lrs.lt): Lietuvos Respublikos pridėtinės vertės mokesčio įstatymas, suvestinė redakcija nuo 2026-07-01 iki 2026-12-31 (DOCX of actual edition); amending law XI-386: https://e-seimas.lrs.lt/portal/legalAct/lt/TAD/TAIS.350400

reduced_rates.scope: accommodation services, regular-route passenger transport and baggage, admission to arts and cultural institutions and events (19 str. 3 d.)

reimbursed and prescription medicines and medical aids, technical aids for disabled persons and their repair, newspapers/periodicals (print and electronic), books and non-periodical information publications (19 str. 4 d.)
exports, intra-EU supplies and other cases in Chapter VI (19 str. 5 d.)

notes: Consolidated versions already published for 2027-01-01 and 2029-07-01 (law XV-1036 of 2026-06-18) keep the 21% standard and 12%/5% reduced rates unchanged. Previously 19% (until 31 Aug 2009). TEDB (situation 2026-07-01) shows 21%, 12%, 5% — consistent.
